claims.claim: Asset identity and rigid structure match the requested identifiers and structure.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json id is lego_02 and kind is rigid; asset/provenance.json objaverse_uid is 9d5df16b87514d06bf9fb5e147509415. asset/model.urdf has one base_link, mass 0.04 kg, and one collision mesh named collision.obj.

claims.claim: The visual model is the requested Lego-style building block.
claims.evidence: renders/iso.png, top.png and side.png show a minifigure with head, torso, arms and legs, rather than a building block. asset/provenance.json names it Lego Man Prop. The requested UID matches, but the requested object description does not.

claims.claim: Overall dimensions are consistent with the declarations and fit the gripper opening.
claims.evidence: readings.json size_cm is [6.0, 3.3, 1.9]; probes/01_geometry_settle.out measures visual extents [0.0600000, 0.0334559, 0.0194493] m, consistent to rounding. Both horizontal extents are below the 0.08 m opening. This establishes dimensional fit only.

claims.claim: Collision geometry follows the visible model without substantial missing surfaces.
claims.evidence: probes/01_geometry_settle.out: visual X maximum is 0.0362186 m, collision X maximum is 0.028449 m, leaving 7.77 mm of visible extent uncovered. With 100000 surface samples per mesh, visual-to-collision nearest-sample distances have p95 6.34 mm, p99 11.59 mm and maximum 13.69 mm. These are substantial gaps relative to the 60 mm object. Both meshes report non-watertight; sampled proximity does not certify cavity preservation.

claims.claim: All joints work throughout their ranges and moving parts remain supported without interpenetration.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: readings.json joints is empty and asset/model.urdf contains one rigid link with no joints.

claims.claim: Each handle is reachable from above and can be pulled along its joint.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: request.md requires no handles and readings.json handles is empty.

claims.claim: Objects placed on each place target settle inside its rim.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The rigid object is upright in its placement frame and stays upright when set on the ground.
claims.evidence: renders/top.png and side.png show the figure's head-to-feet direction along horizontal X rather than vertical Z. probes/01_geometry_settle.out starts fixed=False at z=0.011885 m using exact collision z_min=-0.011885 m. It settles by frame 30 and remains stable through frame 300, but its local Z tilts approximately 10.9 degrees (rotation Rzz=0.98206); it remains a sideways figure. Final origin is [0.00223, 0, 0.01166] m, lowest collision point is approximately 0.00000449 m above ground, and contact forces sum to approximately 0.392 N. Stability is demonstrated, but upright placement is not.

metrics.feedback: Resolve the mismatch between the requested building-block description and the supplied UID's Lego Man Prop: supply the intended building block, or explicitly correct the request if this minifigure is intended. Orient the intended object's upright direction along +Z and provide a stable supporting base in that pose. Rebuild collision.obj to cover the complete visual silhouette and contact surfaces, including the missing positive-X extent, while preserving accessible openings. Recheck collision coverage, top grasp access and free-body upright settling after these changes.
